name: Pinky
description: Let Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any MCP agent operate a real iPhone or Android phone, with risky taps held for your approval and every run recorded, for people automating phone tasks.

skills.name: Operate Phone
skills.description: Observes the phone's screen and taps, swipes, types and opens apps on a real iPhone or Android phone over MCP.

skills.name: Hold for Approval
skills.description: Holds payments, sends, deletions and other risky steps until you click Allow, and hides banking and password apps.

skills.name: Run Phone Task
skills.description: Hands a whole task to Pinky's own model with phone_task_run, then follows, steers or cancels it until it ends.

skills.name: Record Runs
skills.description: Records each step with screenshots and a screen recording, exportable as an HTML report for a bug report or review.

skills.name: Schedule Tasks
skills.description: Runs a phone task at set times or tells you when a condition holds, on the computer and on Android phones.
